Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::inputCard(cardid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		card: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(c|c.CardID = cardid)
	precondition:
		BankCard.allInstance()->isUnique(b: BankCard|b.CardID)
	postcondition:
		if card.oclIsUndefined() 
		then CardIDValidated = false and
		InputCard = null and
		result = false 
		else CardIDValidated = true and
		InputCard = card and
		result = true 
		endif 
}
